AI Writing & Workflow Website Design

My client wanted a modern and engaging website for their AI-powered writing and workflow optimization platform. They needed something that looked professional yet futuristic, with a smooth user experience and clear feature presentation. I designed a dark-themed interface with glowing accents, dynamic pricing sections, and elegant typography to create a premium and tech-driven feel. The site showcases features like AI writing tools, workflow automation, and third-party integrations, all arranged in a clean and intuitive layout. I also included sections for client testimonials, team members, and FAQs to make the platform more trustworthy and user-friendly. My client was very satisfied with the final result, appreciating both the sleek visual style and the smooth overall functionality.

Price range

$5000-$10000

Project duration

1-3 months
